cases.question: How many Nobel Prizes did Marie Curie win?
cases.source_text: 1911 – Marie Curie wins the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, becoming the first person to win two Nobel Prizes.

cases.question: How many Nobel Prizes did the Curie family receive?
cases.source_text: The Curie family received 5 Nobel Prizes.

cases.question: How many Nobel Peace Prizes did the International Committee of the Red Cross receive?
cases.source_text: As a group, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has received the Nobel Peace Prize three times: in 1917, 1944, and 1963.
